title: Hosted sandboxes and a new way to get an API key
summary:
Sandboxes, larger media chats, visible model evals, and community-built tools all got a little easier to use.

Developers can run E2B-compatible sandboxes through gen with existing E2B tools, or manage them with `polli sandbox` and connect over SSH. A completed x402 Pollen-pack purchase now returns a budgeted API key; the checkout page shows payment-method examples relevant to the buyer’s country, and the Machines permission label says plainly what it grants.

The chat API now accepts requests up to 100 MiB with large inline images. It also offloads large data URIs in image, video, and file URL fields, reusing account-scoped uploads across turns instead of sending the same bytes again. Which media types work still depends on the model.

Model Monitor has an Evals tab with weekly Alice and Bowls puzzle scores, past runs, official-versus-community comparisons, and margins of error. Eval runs now pace requests to each model’s advertised rate limit and publish the other scores when one model runs out of retries.

highlights.title: A little room to compute
highlights.text: Create E2B-compatible sandboxes through the gen API or `polli sandbox`, then connect over SSH. The coding-agent template comes with five agents ready to use. [API Docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs)

highlights.title: The models meet Alice
highlights.text: Compare official and community models on weekly puzzle evals, with past runs and uncertainty shown alongside the scores. [See the rankings](https://model-monitor.pollinations.ai)

highlights.title: A bigger picture fits
highlights.text: Send chat requests up to 100 MiB with inline images; large image, video, and file data URLs can be uploaded and reused across turns. [API Docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs)

highlights.title: A new layer of pollen
highlights.text: Generate and edit images directly in Krita, with results placed on new layers. [View repo](https://github.com/xiaotian1171/pollinations-krita)

highlights.title: A bee enters Unity
highlights.text: Add Pollinations-powered chat, image generation, and speech to Unity games with an async C# package. [View repo](https://github.com/Marcus-Mok-GH/pollinations-unity)

highlights.title: Pi gets a proper plug
highlights.text: Run `polli mcp install pi` to add Pollinations to Pi’s native MCP config without disturbing your other servers. [Polli CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli)

highlights.title: The garden gets a gathering place
highlights.text: The Community page now shows live project activity, open votes, and Quest rankings in one place. [Visit the community](https://pollinations.ai)
